address: 57/8 Sisuttha Road, Mak Khaeng, Mueang Udon Thani, Udon Thani, 41000, Thailand
bio: The aroma of beef noodle soup greets diners at this popular eatery. The distinctive tamarind chilli paste pairs perfectly with deep-fried chicken skin or mixed into the noodles. The boat noodles with rich flavours are also a must-try....
